messages:
Liam (Eng Release): Weekly release train - quick heads up for this cycle. Freeze window starts Thu 23:59 UTC. Only P0/P1 bugfixes allowed after that.
Liam (Eng Release): Target rollout: Fri 09:00 UTC -> canary A (09:00), canary B (10:15), full ramp 11:30-13:30 with pauses at 25/50/75%.
Liam (Eng Release): Key checks before canary: green e2e, perf bench p95 < 120ms on staging, no new SLO regressions in last 24h.
Aisha (PM): Quick Q — do feature flags need manual toggle for canary?
Liam (Eng Release): Yes — new feature flags must be gated. If you expect a config change, add the flag name to the release PR description and tag me.
Sam (Platform): Infra note: rolling kernel update scheduled Thu 02:00-06:00 UTC on prod nodes. Impact minimal but IOPS may spike. Recommend avoiding heavy data migrations Thu night.
Maya (SRE): Runbook link: <https://confluence/redwood/releases/runbook-2026-03|runbook-2026-03>. Add your post-deploy smoke checks to the checklist.
Jesse (Devex): Reminder: update the changelog snippet in /changelogs/weekly.md and include the public rollback note if you touch runtime. Small PRs preferred to speed review.
Aisha (PM): We also need a short customer-facing blurb for the Console release — will send copy by EOD.
Maya (SRE): Approvals required for any cherry-pick: @Liam (Eng Release) + @Maya (SRE). Add the label `release/cherry` and link to CI green.
Liam (Eng Release): Exception process: for emergency security patches open an urgent PR and ping #eng-oncall; we will triage immediately.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by liam/release-train at 2026-03-26T09:00:00Z. Jobs queued: build-frontend, build-runtime, integration-tests.
Sam (Platform): I'll watch autoscaler behavior during ramp — will post metrics snapshot at 25%/50%/75%.
Maya (SRE): Will run health checks and post p95/p99 graphs to this thread after each canary.
Liam (Eng Release): If you have migrations, they must be backward compatible. No non-idempotent schema changes during the freeze.
Aisha (PM): Noted. I'll delay the non-critical schema change to next train.
Jesse (Devex): Tiny tip — include a short prompt set when you update generation models so Optimize can check quality quickly.
Liam (Eng Release): Ok team — final reminder: code freeze Thu 23:59 UTC. Post any last-minute asks here and I’ll triage. :rocket:
Maya (SRE): Added a short checklist comment on the runbook, link above.
deploy-bot: build-frontend succeeded (job 4421).
deploy-bot: integration-tests triggered (job 4423).
Liam (Eng Release): Thanks all — I'll post a final "go/no-go" at Fri 08:30 UTC with the canary start command.
Aisha (PM): Thanks, noted.
Sam (Platform): 👍
Maya (SRE): :eyes:
